      [{

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Respaid debt-collection campaign by importing a batch of invoices/debtor records (each with debtor contact details, due amount, and invoice info). Use to kick off collection on a set of unpaid invoices. Requires importData to be an array of invoice objects; creates a new campaign on every call, so it is not idempotent.

stop_collection_client_paid_directly.name: stop_collection_client_paid_directly
stop_collection_client_paid_directly.displayName: Stop Collection for Direct Full Payment
stop_collection_client_paid_directly.description: Stops the collection process for a case and mark it as paid directly to the creditor.

aiMetadata.description: Halts the Respaid collection process for a single case and marks the debt as paid in full directly to the creditor (outside Respaid). Use when a debtor settled the invoice with the creditor directly. The case must be identified by either unique_identifier or email (one is required); it mutates case state, so it is not idempotent.

stop_collection_for_direct_partial_payme.name: stop_collection_for_direct_partial_payment
stop_collection_for_direct_partial_payme.displayName: Stop Collection for Direct Partial Payment
stop_collection_for_direct_partial_payme.description: Stops the collection process for a case and mark it as partially paid directly to the creditor.

aiMetadata.description: Halts the Respaid collection process for a single case and records a partial payment made directly to the creditor (outside Respaid), passing the paid amount. Use when a debtor settled part of the invoice with the creditor directly. The case must be identified by either unique_identifier or email (one is required); it records a payment and mutates case state, so it is not idempotent.

stop_collection_for_direct_instalment_pa.name: stop_collection_for_direct_instalment_payment
stop_collection_for_direct_instalment_pa.displayName: Stop Collection for Direct Instalment Payment
stop_collection_for_direct_instalment_pa.description: Stops the collection process for a case when an instalment plan is set up with the creditor.

aiMetadata.description: Halts the Respaid collection process for a single case because the debtor and creditor agreed on a direct instalment (payment plan) arrangement. Use when collection should pause in favour of a creditor-side instalment plan rather than full settlement. The case must be identified by either unique_identifier or email (one is required); it mutates case state, so it is not idempotent.

new_campaign_creation.name: new_campaign_creation
new_campaign_creation.description: Triggers when the campaign is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Respaid finishes processing a campaign import, reporting the outcome: which imported invoice records were accepted (valid) versus rejected (invalid, e.g. bad email), and a link to the processing report. Use to react to the result of creating a collection campaign.

new_cancelled_case.name: new_cancelled_case
new_cancelled_case.description: Triggers when a collection process for a given sequence (case) was cancelled.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when the collection process for a debtor case (sequence) is cancelled, carrying the debtor/invoice details and the cancellation reason. Use to react to a case being dropped from active collection.

new_disputed_case.name: new_disputed_case
new_disputed_case.description: Triggers when a collection process was disputed by the debtor.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debtor disputes (contests) an ongoing collection case, carrying the debtor/invoice details plus the dispute context and any attachment. Use to react to a contested debt that may need manual review.

sampleData.name: John Doe
sampleData.context:
Q: In order to stop the proceedings against you and not increase the amount of the debt, we can offer you
A: Payment in instalments of up to 5 months (activation of instalments within 1 working day).
Q: Do you agree to sign the following mandate?
A: I agree

new_payout.name: new_payout
new_payout.description: Triggers when a payout is successfully sent to your bank account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Respaid sends a payout to your bank account, carrying the payout id, date, and the list of collected payments (with amounts and fees) bundled into that payout. Use to reconcile disbursed collections against your bank deposits.

new_successful_collection_paid_to_credit.name: new_successful_collection_paid_to_creditor
new_successful_collection_paid_to_credit.displayName: New Successful Collection Paid to Creditor
new_successful_collection_paid_to_credit.description: Triggers when a debt is paid directly to the creditor.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debt is paid in full directly to the creditor (outside Respaid), carrying the debtor/invoice details, amount, and payment timestamp. Use to react to a full settlement that bypassed Respaid.

new_successful_installment_payment_via_r.name: new_successful_installment_payment_via_respaid
new_successful_installment_payment_via_r.displayName: New Successful Installment Payment via Respaid
new_successful_installment_payment_via_r.description: Triggers when one of the installment payments is made for a given case within a collection's payment plan.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debtor makes one installment payment within a Respaid payment plan, carrying the debtor/invoice details, paid amount, current installment step, total installments, and remaining balance. Use to track progress through a collection's installment schedule.

new_successful_collection_via_legal_offi.name: new_successful_collection_via_legal_officer
new_successful_collection_via_legal_offi.displayName: New Successful Collection via Legal Officer
new_successful_collection_via_legal_offi.description: Triggers when a debt is paid to the Legal Officer responsible for the collection campaign.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debt is paid to the legal officer handling the collection campaign, carrying the debtor/invoice details, amount, and payment timestamp. Use to react to a settlement collected through the legal channel.

new_successful_partial_payment_to_credit.name: new_successful_partial_payment_to_creditor
new_successful_partial_payment_to_credit.displayName: New Successful Partial Payment to Creditor
new_successful_partial_payment_to_credit.description: Triggers when the debt is partially paid directly to the creditor.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debt is partially paid directly to the creditor (outside Respaid), carrying the debtor/invoice details, the paid amount, and the remaining balance. Use to react to a partial settlement that bypassed Respaid.

new_successful_partial_payment_via_respa.name: new_successful_partial_payment_via_respaid
new_successful_partial_payment_via_respa.displayName: New Successful Partial Payment via Respaid
new_successful_partial_payment_via_respa.description: Triggers when the debt is partially paid via Respaid's payment link.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debt is partially paid online through Respaid's payment link, carrying the debtor/invoice details, the paid amount, and the remaining balance. Use to react to a partial settlement collected via Respaid.

new_successful_collection_via_respaid.name: new_successful_collection_via_respaid
new_successful_collection_via_respaid.description: Triggers when a debt is paid online via Respaid's payment link.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a debt is paid in full online through Respaid's payment link, carrying the debtor/invoice details, amount, payment mode, and timestamp. Use to react to a full settlement collected via Respaid.
